# Agent Python Tools

## File: facebookresearch_dinov2/dinov2/eval/segmentation_m2f/models/decode_heads/mask2former_head.py

Prompts

```
['build a Mask2FormerHead instance with configurable num_queries, pixel_decoder, and transformer_decoder for universal image segmentation', 'run the Mask2FormerHead forward pass on multi-scale features to get classification and mask prediction logits', 'compute classification, mask, and dice losses for all decoder layers during training', 'run inference with Mask2FormerHead to produce predicted semantic segmentation masks from multi-level features', 'run the forward_head method to compute classification scores, mask predictions, and attention masks after each decoder layer']
```

Usage

```
{'build_Mask2FormerHead': 'build a Mask2FormerHead instance with configurable num_queries, pixel_decoder, and transformer_decoder for universal image segmentation', 'forward_Mask2FormerHead': 'run the Mask2FormerHead forward pass on multi-scale features to get classification and mask prediction logits', 'loss_Mask2FormerHead': 'compute classification, mask, and dice losses for all decoder layers during training', 'forward_test_Mask2FormerHead': 'run inference with Mask2FormerHead to produce predicted semantic segmentation masks from multi-level features', 'forward_head_Mask2FormerHead': 'run the forward_head method to compute classification scores, mask predictions, and attention masks after each decoder layer'}
```
